text.en:
Revised Edition of the Laws Act
(CHAPTER 275)
Order under Section 11(3)
Whereas pursuant to section 10 of the Revised Edition of the Laws Act, the Law Revision Commissioners have published in loose-leaf form the Acts set out in the Schedule as in force on 1st June 2011:
And Whereas it is provided under section 11(3) of the Revised Edition of the Laws Act that the Commissioners shall transmit to the President a copy of the loose-leaf edition of each of these Acts and the President may thereupon, by order published in the Gazette, specify that the loose-leaf edition of these Acts shall, in all courts and for all purposes, be the sole and only proper law of Singapore in respect of those Acts:
Now therefore it is hereby ordered by the President that the loose-leaf edition of these Acts shall, with effect from 15th July 2011, be the sole and only proper law of Singapore in respect of those Acts.

THE SCHEDULE
1. Finance Companies Act (Chapter 108)
2. Presidential Elections Act (Chapter 240A)
3. Tobacco (Control of Advertisements and Sale) Act (Chapter 309)
